review_method: Failure-oriented second inspection of the actual pinned 1190x1740 original printed JPEG after first-reader JSON freeze, in the SAME GPT-6 conversation/context. Source image only, no embedded OCR or peer reading used. This is a logically distinct adversarial purpose but not a separate blind image-only reader or an independent third adjudicator. Especially in the dense archaic Cyrillic words, proposed Unicode vowels, titla, editorial brackets and numeral marks may be incorrect. No CER gold or scholarly verified text.

source_spot_checks.image_evidence: Top right Roman folio XLIX is separately printed and not scan-index 58.
First four body lines discuss copyist hands at manuscript pages 1120–1146; starts with indent then prose.
Second block includes Franko's Ukrainian prose and a shorter old-Cyrillic incipit within physical printed rows, with abbreviated letters and titla.
Long Adam quotation interleaved with editorial framing and reference lines; many old Cyrillic letters, supralinear marks and bracketed restorations, poor source certainty.
Footer at left reads 'Апокріфи старозавітні.' distinct from manuscript and body.
Printer's right-margin signature '7', distinct from XLIX folio and quoted source numerals.

additional_adversarial_observations.source_evidence: First quoted original title appears letterspaced and printed in old Cyrillic. The source may have a different first vowel/title ending than Книгѣ. No dictionary-driven repair is permitted.
The proposed superscript abbreviation sequence is not visually certain; the character combinations used in the first draft must not be treated as measured Unicode diplomatic gold.
The phrase 'створн ан҃лы' is suspicious even as a transcription hypothesis and could contain a substitution/omitted titlo; further high-resolution reading essential.
The first long Adam quotation starts in the same physical row as Franko's commentary; check the opening quote, bracket and source font change.
The abbreviation m҃ти and phrase concerning Eve and Adam may have alternate letters; multiple historical characters are unresolved.
The proposed ѕ҃ numeral and repeated punctuation around часовъ may differ in printed source, making a numerically significant uncertainty.
Source numeral м҃ may encode a different count from the proposed codepoint; keep tentative rather than equating to modern number.
Church-liturgical abbreviations and apparently obsolete vowels are densely printed; overletter positions need separate image inspection.
The final 'Коментуючи' is a new Franko editorial clause after an archaic quotation in the SAME physical line, not a separate physical row.
The line 'Апокріфи старозавітні.' is a printer/running footer, not the manuscript quotation or the printed folio.
Bottom-right 7 is a printer signature, while the observed XLIX at top is the printed folio.
